book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Preya wulijim YAWEI gin maindimbat mi

content.text: YAWEI irrim dislot wed mi toktok.
Teiknodis langa wanim mi jinggabat.
Irrim mi wen mi jingat langa yu blanga album mi,
dumaji mi prei langa yu main God en main king.
Ailibala yu irrim mi wen mi tok langa yu, YAWEI.
Ailibala mi prei langa yu,
en mi weit blanga luk hau yu garra ensim mi.
Yu na det God hu heidim nogudbala ting,
en nogudbala pipul kaan jidan garram yu.
Praudbala pipul kaan kaman blanga jidan garram yu.
Brabliwei yu nomo laigim ola pipul hu dum ola nogudbala ting.
Yu binijimap laiyinbala pipul.
Yu heidim detlot hu dalim ola laiyawan wed blanga meigim pipul nogudbinji,
en detlot hu oldei medrim pipul, yu heidim detmatj.
Bat dumaji yu laigim mi detmatj,
ai gin kaman langa yu Serramoni Pleis.
Dumaji mi bradin en rispek langa yu,
mi tenim miselp langa yu Seikridwan Pleis en weship yu.
YAWEI, mi garram loda enami.
Dalim mi blanga detlot raitwan ting ai garra dum,
en lidim mi langa det streitwei blanga go.
Dei oldei tok laiyawan wed.
Insaid langa olabat hat dei oldei jinggabat blanga binijimap pipul.
Wen dei opinim olabat mawus en tok detlot wed,
dei tok trikibalawei wulijim detlot pipul gitkil.
Dalim olabat dei gilti.
Panishim olabat, God.
Deibin meigim plen mijamet blanga ardim najalot pipul.
Yu ardim olabat det seimwei na.
Jandimwei olabat dumaji deibin nogudbala detmatj.
Andimwei olabat dumaji deibin gibit bekboun langa yu.
Bat ol detlot pipul hu trastim yu blanga kipum olabat seif garra oldei sing langa yu gudbinjiwei.
Yu blandim olabat brom olabat enamimob,
en olabat garra oldei preisimbat yu.
Yu oldei jidan garram detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei langa yu.
Yu blokim ola nogudbala ting brom olabat laiga shild,
dumaji yu brabli kainbala langa yu pipul olabat.
